seoPreview.title: Illustrative search preview
seoPreview.note: Search engines may display different text.

create.title: New category
create.description: Enter a working name in the current language. Nothing is saved yet; you will complete the full editor first.
create.name: Name
create.editorDescription: Complete both addresses and all language content. The category is created only after the first successful save.

move.title: Move category
move.description: Choose a new parent. The category will be appended there without renumbering siblings.

publish.title: Publish this category?
publish.description: Publication is allowed only when the category and its specifications are ready in all languages.

unpublish.title: Unpublish this category?
unpublish.description: The category will return to draft. Existing dependency rules still apply.

archive.title: Archive this category?
archive.description: The category will be retained but removed from active use. Existing dependency rules still apply.

restore.title: Restore this category?
restore.description: The category will be restored as a draft.

messages.PARENT_NOT_PUBLISHED: The parent category must be published first.
